skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of risk and risk management methods, the role of insurance and key operating principles of insurance.

Grasp the characteristics of various types of insurance, legal regulations in insurance operations, transactions implemented in insurance activities, and the system of information technology and communication in insurance activities.
Comprehend the relevant issues related to policies and laws of various types of insurance.

Understand the various types of insurance, objects, scope, formation of insurance funds, issues in insurance business operations, and implementation of social health insurance, medical insurance, unemployment insurance, and other types of insurance.

Understand the issues related to relationships in insurance business transactions such as insurance request forms, insurance policies, insurance certificates, insurance renewals, insurance sales, insurance premiums, complaints, and resolution of insurance disputes.
Understand the operation of communication in insurance, the necessity and selection of IT in insurance operations.
Develop the ability to synthesize, analyze, and systematic thinking.
Demonstrate responsibility for individual work and group work.
Develop research and independent working abilities, analytical and logical reasoning skills, teamwork skills, presentation skills, problem-solving skills, and leadership skills.
